description_en: Import phone numbers for the outbound call task
description_zh: 为外呼任务导入任务号码
kebab_example: aliyun dyvmsapi cloud-import-task-tel --enterprise-id 17 --name '批次名称1' --task-id 25 --task-tel-list ClidGroup=example Clid=7766551 Priority=38 Tel=7455441 Property=example-string BackupTels=7455332 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CloudImportTaskTel

parameters.help_en: The ID of the call center
parameters.name: enterprise_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the batch. If you specify this parameter, the numbers are added to the existing batch
parameters.help_zh: 批次Id；传此值表示在批次中增加号码
parameters.name: file_id

parameters.help_en: The priority of the batch. The default value is 0. A larger value indicates a higher priority. The maximum value is 999999
parameters.help_zh: 优先级；默认0，值越大越优先，最大999999
parameters.name: priority

parameters.help_en:
Specifies the deduplication policy. Default value: 1. Valid values:

0: Disables deduplication.

1: Deduplicates numbers within the current task.

2: Deduplicates numbers in the current import.

3: Deduplicates numbers within the current batch.

Deduplication within a task and deduplication within a batch cannot be enabled at the same time. If you switch between these policies, the new policy applies to subsequent imports
parameters.help_zh:
是否排重，默认为1。
0：不排重
1：任务内排重
2：导入号码排重
3：批次内排重

任务内排重与批次内排重不能同时支持，如果中途切换，则从本次切换开始进行排重
parameters.name: is_repeat

parameters.help_en: Specifies the voice file from the enterprise voice library that plays as an opening statement for both parties when an agent answers a call
parameters.help_zh: 座席接听时自动在双侧播放开场白语音，指定语音变量值；企业语音库里的语音变量值
parameters.name: bridge_voice_path

parameters.help_en:
The type of the opening statement audio to play when an agent answers a call. This parameter takes effect only if `BridgeVoicePath` is specified. Default value: 3. Valid values:

1: A file from the public voice library.

2: A static script from the enterprise voice library.

3: A dynamic script from the enterprise voice library (which can include variables such as the agent ID)
parameters.help_zh:
座席接听时自动在双侧播放开场白语音类型，默认为3。
1：公共语音库；
2：企业语音库，静态话术；
3：企业语音库，动态话术（座席号），传bridgeVoicePath后生效
parameters.name: bridge_voice_type

fields.help_en: A comma-separated list of up to eight backup numbers to call if the primary number (specified by `Tel`) is unreachable
fields.help_zh: 备选号码，tel呼叫不通时，呼叫备选号码最多支持8个，号码之间用英文逗号","分隔
fields.name: backup_tels

fields.help_en: The caller ID to display for the phone number
fields.help_zh: 电话号对应的外显号码
fields.name: clid

fields.help_en: Your account must support routing by identifier to use this parameter. If you specify this parameter, the `Clid` parameter becomes invalid
fields.help_zh: 使用clidGroup需要账号支持按标识路由，使用此参数是clid参数无效
fields.name: clid_group

fields.help_en: The priority of the number. The default value is 0. A larger value indicates a higher priority. The maximum value is 999999
fields.help_zh: 优先级，默认为0，值越大优先级越高，最大999999
fields.name: priority

fields.help_en: Custom properties for the number, in JSON format
fields.name: property

parameters.help_en: A list of numbers to import for the task. The size of the request body cannot exceed 8 MB. In a `CtiLinkTaskTel` object, only the `Tel` field is required. Note: Configure [event notification](../%E5%AD%97%E6%AE%B5%E5%AE%9A%E4%B9%89/%E6%8E%A8%E9%80%81%E5%8F%98%E9%87%8F%E5%92%8C%E5%80%BC/%E9%A2%84%E6%B5%8B%E5%A4%96%E5%91%BC%E5%AF%BC%E5%85%A5%E5%8F%B7%E7%A0%81%E5%A4%B1%E8%B4%A5%E6%8E%A8%E9%80%81%E5%8F%98%E9%87%8F.md) to receive details about failed imports
parameters.help_zh: 任务号码列表；CtiLinkTaskTel中只有Tel是必选字段，长度大小不超过8MB 注：获取导入失败明细，需配置[事件推送](../字段定义/推送变量和值/预测外呼导入号码失败推送变量.md)
parameters.name: task_tel_list

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to automatically start the task after the import is complete. Default value: 0. Valid values:

0: Does not automatically start the task.

1: Automatically starts the task
parameters.help_zh:
是否自动启动任务，默认为0。
0：不自动启动
1：自动启动
parameters.name: import_tel_auto_start

Data.description_en: The object containing the returned data

FileId.description_en: The ID of the imported file

ImportTotal.description_en: The total number of items in the import request

SuccessTotal.description_en: The number of successfully imported items

TaskId.description_en: The ID of the import task
